task.object: Finite labelled recolouring fibres, cycles and paths, protected-edge seeds, pools and interfaces

assumptions: Five-colour adjacent-pair lists have size three or four; only one list changes at an interface
Four-colour path boundaries have three labelled entries
Four-colour pentagon boundaries have five entries, at most one full list; that position is fixed along an interface
The first normalizer follows the exact start/sign/permutation order in the article
mathematical_context.domain: Exact finite graphs, finite sets of labelled colour words, and integer counts

python.existence_evidence: Python standard-library implementations delivered in supplement/ and executed successfully.
python.availability_evidence: Live Python 3.14.6; all three suites and nine negative cases passed in both workspace and the concise standalone package.

decision.selection_reason: Exact replay of small finite certificate domains; direct source parsing and integer/set operations provide a portable standard-library implementation.
decision.fallback_reason: not-required: selected route completed every requested finite check without approximation

execution.command_or_input: From the package root: python3 supplement/verify_all.py; python3 build.py

result.summary: All 3,225 pair interfaces / 27,600 entries, 504 directed path transitions / 720 cycle pairs, and all 313 pentagon interfaces passed. Both hard three-row seeds retain 13 common ports in every row. All nine corrupted inputs were rejected. The concise 24-page article and 12-page supplement rebuilt byte-identically in the standalone package; 55 marked blocks and 53 endpoint words are unchanged.

methods: Literal-source path/cycle adjacency and exact complete-state enumeration
Independent endpoint feasibility cross-check by subset dynamic programming
Exact first-normalizer/inverse-map and physical-coordinate pool/protection checks
Reconstruction of hard three-row seed cycles and per-row common-port checks
Exhaustive interface classification and 47+236+30 partition check
Nine negative cases and standalone package replay
LaTeX warning and page-bound checks plus visual PDF inspection
verification.residual_or_error: No floating-point computation; residual not applicable.
limitations: Finite verifiers certify local lemmas; arbitrary-order induction, bad-run lifting and tree splicing remain analytic arguments in the article.
This record is not a formal verification or an independent peer-review certificate of the complete manuscript.
General planar girth-five four-colour Hamiltonian and Hamilton-connected statements remain open.
